summary: # **CENTRAL ELECTRICITY REGULATORY COMMISSION NEW DELHI** # ** Petition No.138/MP/2022 ** **Coram:** **Shri P.K.Pujari, Chairperson Shri I.S.Jha, Member** **Shri Arun Goyal, Member Shri P.K.Singh, Member** **Date of Order: 27** **th** **May, 2022** # **In the matter of** Petition seeking permission to continue drawal of start-up power from the grid as per Deviation Settlement Mechanism (DSM) till first synchronization of KAPP-4 or 2.7.2023, whichever is earlier. # **And In the matter of** Nuclear Power Corporation of India Limited (NPCIL), Nabhikiya Urja Bhavan/ Vikram Sarabhai Bhavan, Anushaktinagar, Mumbai, Maharashtra – 400094 **...Petitioner** **Vs.** Western Regional Load Dispatch Centre, F-3, MIDC Area, Andheri (East), Mumbai-400 093 ** Respondent** # ** ORDER ** This Petition has been filed by the Petitioner, Nuclear Power Corporation of India Limiter under Clause (7) of Regulation 8 of the Central Electricity Regulatory Commission (Grant of Connectivity, Long-term Access and Medium term Open access in inter-State transmission and related matters) Regulations, 2009 (hereinafter referred to as “the Connectivity Regulations‟) with the following prayers: _“(a) Permit drawl of start-up power from the grid under Deviation Settlement Mechanism (DSM) for KAPP-4 commissioning till synchronization of KAPP-4 or 2.7.2023, whichever is earlier._ _(b) Pass such order(s) as deemed fit by the Commission.”_ -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------Order in Petition No. 138/MP/2022 **1** of Page **1** of **4** 2. Kakrapar Atomic Power Project 3 and 4 of the Petitioner is located at Kakrapar, Surat District in the State of Gujarat and is being implemented in two stages consisting of Unit-I and Unit-II of 700 MW each. The project is first indigenous 700 MW Pressurised Heavy Water Reactor (PHWR). Kakrapar Atomic Power Project 4 (in short ‘KAPP-4’) started drawing start-up power from 2.4.2021, the permission for which is expiring on 2.7.2022. 3. The Petitioner has submitted that the first synchronization of KAPP-4 is expected by 2.7.2023 and it could not be synchronized due to the following reasons: (a) Construction and commissioning activities of main plant system e.g. Primary Heat Transport (PHT) system, moderator system, TG and secondary cycle system could not be completed within the prescribed period due to surge in Covid-10 pandemic from March, 2021, which led to restrictions on inter-State movement of equipment and personnel, etc. and effected the contractor and vendor support for ongoing activities at site. (b) All efforts are being made to expedite plant commissioning. A major milestone i.e PHT main system hydro test was conducted on 27.4.2022. (c) In line with KAPP-3, major modification works on civil structural beams and ventilation systems of reactor building need to be carried out, which is mandatory requirement for starting PHT hot conditioning. Subsequent milestones in KAPP-4 commissioning such as fuel loading, heavy water addition, first criticality and synchronization will be achieved after stage-wise clearances. 4. The Petitioner has submitted the current status of works of the project as under: (a) 400 kV switchyard has been charged and all 400 kV transmission lines are in service. Start-up transformer (220/6.6 kV) has been charged and station auxiliary electrical system buses are being commissioned and are into service. -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------Order in Petition No. 138/MP/2022 **2** of Page **2** of **4** (b) Station auxiliary system i.e fire water system, service water system, chilled water system, compressed air system & diesel oil storage and transfer system are in advance stage of commissioning. (c) All four emergency diesel generators have been commissioned. (d) Turbine generator set and its auxiliary system erection is in progress. (e) PHT system tight water commissioning is in progress. (f) PHT system light water commissioning is in progress. (f) PHT system hydro test was completed in the last week of April, 2022. (g) PHT system has been designed as per ASME Section-III NB. PHT system pipelines are made of carbon steel and 392 coolant channel pressure tubes are made of zirconium with 2.5% niobium. (h) 80% of main plant instrumentation works have been completed. TG and secondary cycle system instrumentation is in progress. - (i) Reactor building structural beam modification works are pending and will be carried out after implementation in Unit-3. (j) PHT hot conditioning will commence during the last quarter of 2022. - (k) Reactor is expected to become critical and start sustained chain reaction in the first quarter of 2023. 5. The Petitioner has submitted that due to reasons beyond its control, it could not synchronize KAPP-4. The Petitioner has requested to grant permission for drawl of start-up power from the grid beyond 2.7.2022 till synchronization of KAPP4 or 2.7.2023, whichever is earlier. 6. The Petition is admitted by circulation. 7. We have considered the submissions of the Petitioner. The fourth and fifth provisos to Regulation 8(7) of the Connectivity Regulations provides as under: _“Provided that the Commission may in exceptional circumstances, allow extension of the period for inter-change of power beyond the period as prescribed in this clause, on an application made by the generating station at least two months in advance of completion of the prescribed period:_ _Provided further that the concerned Regional Load Despatch Centre while granting such permission shall keep the grid security in view.”_ 8. The Petitioner has submitted that 700 MW PHWR being a new system, structure and components are being incorporated for establishing robustness in design, erection and operation based upon regulatory recommendations. The -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------Order in Petition No. 138/MP/2022 **3** of Page **3** of **4** Petitioner has submitted that due to Covid-19 pandemic, KAPP-4 could not be synchronized. Accordingly, the Petitioner has sought permission for drawl of startup power from the grid till synchronization or 2.7.2023, whichever is earlier. 9. We are of the view that non-availability of start-up power would hamper the progress of commissioning work and result in further delay in synchronisation of KAPP-4. Accordingly, we allow extension of time for drawl of start-up power from the grid up to synchronization of KAPP-4 or 2.7.2023, whichever is earlier. We expect the Petitioner to make all efforts to ensure the synchronization of KAPP-4 of the project by this date. 10. In terms of above, the Petition No.138/MP/2022 is disposed of. **Sd/sd/sd/sd/(P.K.Singh) (Arun Goyal) (I.S.Jha) (P.K. Pujari) Member Member Member Chairperson** -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------Order in Petition No. 138/MP/2022 **4** of Page **4** of **4** CERC Website S.
